title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Removal Credit Computation
content:
The removal credit of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider is the following quantity, worked out on the removal date.

## Terms

- **Retained rider premium**: the rider premium paid with an entry date in the current term, less the billing corrections credited with an entry date in the current term.
- **Unearned share of the removal credit**: the whole months from the removal date to the term end date, divided by the whole months from the later of the term start date and the add date to the term end date, counting that divisor as at least one month.
- **Unearned removal premium**: the retained rider premium multiplied by the unearned share of the removal credit, rounded to the cent.
- **Removal retention**: the unearned removal premium multiplied by the removal retention rate, which is 0.10 (10 percent), rounded to the cent.
- **Removal processing fee**: USD 25.00.
- **Removal benefit offset**: the rider benefit authorized in the current term, net of reversals, multiplied by the removal benefit-offset share, which is one, rounded to the cent.
- **Removal credit**: the unearned removal premium, less the removal retention, less the removal processing fee, less the removal benefit offset, rounded to the cent. A negative result is credited as zero.
- **Monthly-billed base**: a rider removed from a monthly-billed base is credited zero, because its billing simply stops from the next base billing period.
- **Dated in the current term**: an entry counts as dated in the current term when the whole months from its date to the removal date are fewer than one more than the whole months from the term start date to the removal date.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider on an annually billed base, term 1 January through 31 December, added on 1 January, removed on 10 May. Rider premium paid in the term: USD 161.89; no billing corrections; rider benefit authorized in the term, net of reversals: USD 40.00.

| Line | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Retained rider premium | 161.89 less 0.00 | 161.89 |
| Whole months, 10 May to 31 December | | 7 |
| Whole months, 1 January to 31 December | | 11 |
| Unearned removal premium | 161.89 multiplied by 7 divided by 11, rounded | 103.02 |
| Removal retention | 103.02 multiplied by 0.10, rounded | 10.30 |
| Removal processing fee | | 25.00 |
| Removal benefit offset | 40.00 multiplied by one | 40.00 |
| Removal credit | 103.02 less 10.30 less 25.00 less 40.00 | 27.72 |

With USD 100.00 of rider benefit authorized in the term instead, the result would be 103.02 less 10.30 less 25.00 less 100.00, a negative figure, and the removal credit would be zero.

The same rider on a monthly-billed base is credited zero.
